# Tempus Fugit

> Landing page for the personal VPS at outpost.higherlearning.eu — the page
> you get when you hit the server without asking for any particular
> service. A single hero page with a running millisecond counter; there is
> no other content on this site.

## Pages

- [Tempus Fugit](https://outpost.higherlearning.eu/): the hero page itself, the only real page on the site.
